image_description:
## 1) Chart type
Faceted vertical bar chart (small-multiple time-series bar charts), with one panel per city.

## 2) Layout techniques
- **Faceting / small multiples** by **city**
- **Unequal panel sizes**: some cities (notably New Delhi) are shown in larger panels
- **Color encoding** applied to bars to indicate pollution level / air quality category
- **No stacking** visible

## 3) Data variables

| Data Variable | Type of Variable | Visual Encoding |
|---|---|---|
| Date / day (Nov ’18 to Nov ’19) | Temporal | Position on x-axis within each panel |
| PM2.5 concentration (µg/m³) | Quantitative | Bar height / position on y-axis |
| Air quality level / EPA AQI category (Good, Unhealthy, Hazardous, Extreme) | Ordinal | Color/hue of bars |
| City | Categorical/nominal | Faceting into separate panels; panel labels |
| PM2.5 concentration scale reference | Quantitative | Legend scale and y-axis annotations/gridlines |

Notes visible in the chart:
- Title indicates the subject is **daily average air pollution around the world**
- The legend explicitly links color to **PM2.5 concentration** and **E.P.A. Air Quality Index** categories.

## 1) Chart type
Faceted vertical bar chart (small-multiple time-series bar charts), with one panel per city.

## 2) Layout techniques
- **Faceting / small multiples** by **city**
- **Unequal panel sizes**: some cities (notably New Delhi) are shown in larger panels
- **Color encoding** applied to bars to indicate pollution level / air quality category
- **No stacking** visible

## 3) Data variables

| Data Variable | Type of Variable | Visual Encoding |
|---|---|---|
| Date / day (Nov ’18 to Nov ’19) | Temporal | Position on x-axis within each panel |
| PM2.5 concentration (µg/m³) | Quantitative | Bar height / position on y-axis |
| Air quality level / EPA AQI category (Good, Unhealthy, Hazardous, Extreme) | Ordinal | Color/hue of bars |
| City | Categorical/nominal | Faceting into separate panels; panel labels |
| PM2.5 concentration scale reference | Quantitative | Legend scale and y-axis annotations/gridlines |

Notes visible in the chart:
- Title indicates the subject is **daily average air pollution around the world**
- The legend explicitly links color to **PM2.5 concentration** and **E.P.A. Air Quality Index** categories.

image_description:
## 1) Chart type
Faceted vertical bar chart (small-multiple time-series bar charts), with one panel per city.

## 2) Layout techniques
- **Faceting / small multiples** by **city**
- **Unequal panel sizes**: some cities (notably New Delhi) are shown in larger panels
- **Color encoding** applied to bars to indicate pollution level / air quality category
- **No stacking** visible

## 3) Data variables

| Data Variable | Type of Variable | Visual Encoding |
|---|---|---|
| Date / day (Nov ’18 to Nov ’19) | Temporal | Position on x-axis within each panel |
| PM2.5 concentration (µg/m³) | Quantitative | Bar height / position on y-axis |
| Air quality level / EPA AQI category (Good, Unhealthy, Hazardous, Extreme) | Ordinal | Color/hue of bars |
| City | Categorical/nominal | Faceting into separate panels; panel labels |
| PM2.5 concentration scale reference | Quantitative | Legend scale and y-axis annotations/gridlines |

Notes visible in the chart:
- Title indicates the subject is **daily average air pollution around the world**
- The legend explicitly links color to **PM2.5 concentration** and **E.P.A. Air Quality Index** categories.

## 1) Chart type
Faceted vertical bar chart (small-multiple time-series bar charts), with one panel per city.

## 2) Layout techniques
- **Faceting / small multiples** by **city**
- **Unequal panel sizes**: some cities (notably New Delhi) are shown in larger panels
- **Color encoding** applied to bars to indicate pollution level / air quality category
- **No stacking** visible

## 3) Data variables

| Data Variable | Type of Variable | Visual Encoding |
|---|---|---|
| Date / day (Nov ’18 to Nov ’19) | Temporal | Position on x-axis within each panel |
| PM2.5 concentration (µg/m³) | Quantitative | Bar height / position on y-axis |
| Air quality level / EPA AQI category (Good, Unhealthy, Hazardous, Extreme) | Ordinal | Color/hue of bars |
| City | Categorical/nominal | Faceting into separate panels; panel labels |
| PM2.5 concentration scale reference | Quantitative | Legend scale and y-axis annotations/gridlines |

Notes visible in the chart:
- Title indicates the subject is **daily average air pollution around the world**
- The legend explicitly links color to **PM2.5 concentration** and **E.P.A. Air Quality Index** categories.

## 1) Chart type
Faceted vertical bar chart (small-multiple time-series bar charts), with one panel per city.

## 2) Layout techniques
- **Faceting / small multiples** by **city**
- **Unequal panel sizes**: some cities (notably New Delhi) are shown in larger panels
- **Color encoding** applied to bars to indicate pollution level / air quality category
- **No stacking** visible

## 3) Data variables

| Data Variable | Type of Variable | Visual Encoding |
|---|---|---|
| Date / day (Nov ’18 to Nov ’19) | Temporal | Position on x-axis within each panel |
| PM2.5 concentration (µg/m³) | Quantitative | Bar height / position on y-axis |
| Air quality level / EPA AQI category (Good, Unhealthy, Hazardous, Extreme) | Ordinal | Color/hue of bars |
| City | Categorical/nominal | Faceting into separate panels; panel labels |
| PM2.5 concentration scale reference | Quantitative | Legend scale and y-axis annotations/gridlines |

Notes visible in the chart:
- Title indicates the subject is **daily average air pollution around the world**
- The legend explicitly links color to **PM2.5 concentration** and **E.P.A. Air Quality Index** categories.

Faceted vertical bar chart (small-multiple time-series bar charts), with one panel per city.

## 2) Layout techniques
- **Faceting / small multiples** by **city**
- **Unequal panel sizes**: some cities (notably New Delhi) are shown in larger panels
- **Color encoding** applied to bars to indicate pollution level / air quality category
- **No stacking** visible

## 3) Data variables

| Data Variable | Type of Variable | Visual Encoding |
|---|---|---|
| Date / day (Nov ’18 to Nov ’19) | Temporal | Position on x-axis within each panel |
| PM2.5 concentration (µg/m³) | Quantitative | Bar height / position on y-axis |
| Air quality level / EPA AQI category (Good, Unhealthy, Hazardous, Extreme) | Ordinal | Color/hue of bars |
| City | Categorical/nominal | Faceting into separate panels; panel labels |
| PM2.5 concentration scale reference | Quantitative | Legend scale and y-axis annotations/gridlines |

Notes visible in the chart:
- Title indicates the subject is **daily average air pollution around the world**
- The legend explicitly links color to **PM2.5 concentration** and **E.P.A. Air Quality Index** categories.

| City | Categorical/nominal | Faceting into separate panels; panel labels |
| PM2.5 concentration scale reference | Quantitative | Legend scale and y-axis annotations/gridlines |

Faceted vertical bar chart (small-multiple time-series bar charts), with one panel per city.

## 2) Layout techniques
- **Faceting / small multiples** by **city**
- **Unequal panel sizes**: some cities (notably New Delhi) are shown in larger panels
- **Color encoding** applied to bars to indicate pollution level / air quality category
- **No stacking** visible

## 3) Data variables

| Data Variable | Type of Variable | Visual Encoding |
|---|---|---|
| Date / day (Nov ’18 to Nov ’19) | Temporal | Position on x-axis within each panel |
| PM2.5 concentration (µg/m³) | Quantitative | Bar height / position on y-axis |
| Air quality level / EPA AQI category (Good, Unhealthy, Hazardous, Extreme) | Ordinal | Color/hue of bars |
| City | Categorical/nominal | Faceting into separate panels; panel labels |
| PM2.5 concentration scale reference | Quantitative | Legend scale and y-axis annotations/gridlines |

Notes visible in the chart:
- Title indicates the subject is **daily average air pollution around the world**
- The legend explicitly links color to **PM2.5 concentration** and **E.P.A. Air Quality Index** categories.

| Air quality level / EPA AQI category (Good, Unhealthy, Hazardous, Extreme) | Ordinal | Color/hue of bars |
| City | Categorical/nominal | Faceting into separate panels; panel labels |
| PM2.5 concentration scale reference | Quantitative | Legend scale and y-axis annotations/gridlines |

## 1) Chart type
Faceted vertical bar chart (small-multiple time-series bar charts), with one panel per city.

## 2) Layout techniques
- **Faceting / small multiples** by **city**
- **Unequal panel sizes**: some cities (notably New Delhi) are shown in larger panels
- **Color encoding** applied to bars to indicate pollution level / air quality category
- **No stacking** visible

## 3) Data variables

| Data Variable | Type of Variable | Visual Encoding |
|---|---|---|
| Date / day (Nov ’18 to Nov ’19) | Temporal | Position on x-axis within each panel |
| PM2.5 concentration (µg/m³) | Quantitative | Bar height / position on y-axis |
| Air quality level / EPA AQI category (Good, Unhealthy, Hazardous, Extreme) | Ordinal | Color/hue of bars |
| City | Categorical/nominal | Faceting into separate panels; panel labels |
| PM2.5 concentration scale reference | Quantitative | Legend scale and y-axis annotations/gridlines |

Notes visible in the chart:
- Title indicates the subject is **daily average air pollution around the world**
- The legend explicitly links color to **PM2.5 concentration** and **E.P.A. Air Quality Index** categories.

image_description:
## 1) Chart type
Faceted vertical bar chart (small-multiple time-series bar charts), with one panel per city.

## 2) Layout techniques
- **Faceting / small multiples** by **city**
- **Unequal panel sizes**: some cities (notably New Delhi) are shown in larger panels
- **Color encoding** applied to bars to indicate pollution level / air quality category
- **No stacking** visible

## 3) Data variables

| Data Variable | Type of Variable | Visual Encoding |
|---|---|---|
| Date / day (Nov ’18 to Nov ’19) | Temporal | Position on x-axis within each panel |
| PM2.5 concentration (µg/m³) | Quantitative | Bar height / position on y-axis |
| Air quality level / EPA AQI category (Good, Unhealthy, Hazardous, Extreme) | Ordinal | Color/hue of bars |
| City | Categorical/nominal | Faceting into separate panels; panel labels |
| PM2.5 concentration scale reference | Quantitative | Legend scale and y-axis annotations/gridlines |

Notes visible in the chart:
- Title indicates the subject is **daily average air pollution around the world**
- The legend explicitly links color to **PM2.5 concentration** and **E.P.A. Air Quality Index** categories.
raw_comment:
Thanks to all students who responded. We had so many great catchy headlines that capture the main ideas of these graphs:  “Is Your Air Just Air?” by Conner of Iowa, “Air Pollution Poisoning Many Cities From Around the World." By Ashley of Massachusetts, “Global Air Pollution Trends: Some Cities Breath Easy, While Others Long for a Breath of Fresh Air” by Jacki of Switzerland, “Death in the Air.  O, So Much Despair!” by Mia of Washington, “Air Pollution, the Silent Killer” by Tegan of Kimball Union Academy in Meriden, New Hampshire, and “What Air Do You Breathe In?” by Kayleigh McDonald, Pennsylvania.
 
You can continue to post responses.  Please check back by Friday, Feb. 26 to see the Reveal with a link to the original New York Times article, some questions about the map, and a few Stat Nuggets.
 
Please visit our archive to see all graphs in this series (tinyurl.com/NYTGraphs).
View our archives that link to all past releases, organized by topic (tinyurl.com/NYTGraphsTopicIndex), 
graph type (tinyurl.com/NYTGraphsTypeIndex) and 
Stat Nugget (tinyurl.com/NYTGraphsStatNuggetsIndex). 
 
Signing off – Sharon Hessney of Boston, who welcomes the reenactment of pollution regulations and their enforcement, and Kevin DeVizia of Milford, Pennsylvania, who loves the outdoors and is very happy to live in an area with clean air!

## 1) Chart type
Faceted vertical bar chart (small-multiple time-series bar charts), with one panel per city.

## 2) Layout techniques
- **Faceting / small multiples** by **city**
- **Unequal panel sizes**: some cities (notably New Delhi) are shown in larger panels
- **Color encoding** applied to bars to indicate pollution level / air quality category
- **No stacking** visible

## 3) Data variables

| Data Variable | Type of Variable | Visual Encoding |
|---|---|---|
| Date / day (Nov ’18 to Nov ’19) | Temporal | Position on x-axis within each panel |
| PM2.5 concentration (µg/m³) | Quantitative | Bar height / position on y-axis |
| Air quality level / EPA AQI category (Good, Unhealthy, Hazardous, Extreme) | Ordinal | Color/hue of bars |
| City | Categorical/nominal | Faceting into separate panels; panel labels |
| PM2.5 concentration scale reference | Quantitative | Legend scale and y-axis annotations/gridlines |

Notes visible in the chart:
- Title indicates the subject is **daily average air pollution around the world**
- The legend explicitly links color to **PM2.5 concentration** and **E.P.A. Air Quality Index** categories.

image_description:
## 1) Chart type
Faceted vertical bar chart (small-multiple time-series bar charts), with one panel per city.

## 2) Layout techniques
- **Faceting / small multiples** by **city**
- **Unequal panel sizes**: some cities (notably New Delhi) are shown in larger panels
- **Color encoding** applied to bars to indicate pollution level / air quality category
- **No stacking** visible

## 3) Data variables

| Data Variable | Type of Variable | Visual Encoding |
|---|---|---|
| Date / day (Nov ’18 to Nov ’19) | Temporal | Position on x-axis within each panel |
| PM2.5 concentration (µg/m³) | Quantitative | Bar height / position on y-axis |
| Air quality level / EPA AQI category (Good, Unhealthy, Hazardous, Extreme) | Ordinal | Color/hue of bars |
| City | Categorical/nominal | Faceting into separate panels; panel labels |
| PM2.5 concentration scale reference | Quantitative | Legend scale and y-axis annotations/gridlines |

Notes visible in the chart:
- Title indicates the subject is **daily average air pollution around the world**
- The legend explicitly links color to **PM2.5 concentration** and **E.P.A. Air Quality Index** categories.

## 1) Chart type
Faceted vertical bar chart (small-multiple time-series bar charts), with one panel per city.

## 2) Layout techniques
- **Faceting / small multiples** by **city**
- **Unequal panel sizes**: some cities (notably New Delhi) are shown in larger panels
- **Color encoding** applied to bars to indicate pollution level / air quality category
- **No stacking** visible

## 3) Data variables

| Data Variable | Type of Variable | Visual Encoding |
|---|---|---|
| Date / day (Nov ’18 to Nov ’19) | Temporal | Position on x-axis within each panel |
| PM2.5 concentration (µg/m³) | Quantitative | Bar height / position on y-axis |
| Air quality level / EPA AQI category (Good, Unhealthy, Hazardous, Extreme) | Ordinal | Color/hue of bars |
| City | Categorical/nominal | Faceting into separate panels; panel labels |
| PM2.5 concentration scale reference | Quantitative | Legend scale and y-axis annotations/gridlines |

Notes visible in the chart:
- Title indicates the subject is **daily average air pollution around the world**
- The legend explicitly links color to **PM2.5 concentration** and **E.P.A. Air Quality Index** categories.

The size and population of the city does not determine the air quality as Los Angeles is a huge city, but has good air quality. New Delhi has the worst air quality out of all the cities. We also wondered why New Delhi has the worst air quality, is it because they have a lot of factories that pollute gases? Welcome to Wednesday's moderation of “What’s Going On in This Graph?”  

Today’s graphs show the daily average air pollution in a dozen major cities from around the world for the year Nov. 2018 – Oct. 2019.  Note that all graphs use the same scale to show the number of micrograms per cubic meter of outdoor particulate pollution.  .

From 9 am – 2 pm E.T. today, share with us your responses online to these three questions -- "What do you notice?",  "What do you wonder?", and “What impact does this topic have on you and your community?”

Plus, please share with us a catchy headline that captures the ideas in these graphs. 

By Friday morning, we’ll reveal the article that included these graphs and much more.  We look forward to reading your discoveries.

Note that you can get a link to your response to share with your teacher and classmates by clicking the response box below your response “Email me when my comment is published.”

View our archives that link to all past releases, organized by topic (tinyurl.com/NYTGraphsTopicIndex), 
graph type (tinyurl.com/NYTGraphsTypeIndex) and 
Stat Nugget (tinyurl.com/NYTGraphsStatNuggetsIndex).  

Keep noticing and wondering.  The next graphs on smoking will be released by Friday, Feb. 26, 2021 with moderation on Wednesday, March 3.

## 1) Chart type
Faceted vertical bar chart (small-multiple time-series bar charts), with one panel per city.

## 2) Layout techniques
- **Faceting / small multiples** by **city**
- **Unequal panel sizes**: some cities (notably New Delhi) are shown in larger panels
- **Color encoding** applied to bars to indicate pollution level / air quality category
- **No stacking** visible

## 3) Data variables

| Data Variable | Type of Variable | Visual Encoding |
|---|---|---|
| Date / day (Nov ’18 to Nov ’19) | Temporal | Position on x-axis within each panel |
| PM2.5 concentration (µg/m³) | Quantitative | Bar height / position on y-axis |
| Air quality level / EPA AQI category (Good, Unhealthy, Hazardous, Extreme) | Ordinal | Color/hue of bars |
| City | Categorical/nominal | Faceting into separate panels; panel labels |
| PM2.5 concentration scale reference | Quantitative | Legend scale and y-axis annotations/gridlines |

Notes visible in the chart:
- Title indicates the subject is **daily average air pollution around the world**
- The legend explicitly links color to **PM2.5 concentration** and **E.P.A. Air Quality Index** categories.

Faceted vertical bar chart (small-multiple time-series bar charts), with one panel per city.

- **Faceting / small multiples** by **city**

- **Color encoding** applied to bars to indicate pollution level / air quality category
- **No stacking** visible

## 3) Data variables

| Data Variable | Type of Variable | Visual Encoding |
|---|---|---|
| Date / day (Nov ’18 to Nov ’19) | Temporal | Position on x-axis within each panel |
| PM2.5 concentration (µg/m³) | Quantitative | Bar height / position on y-axis |
| Air quality level / EPA AQI category (Good, Unhealthy, Hazardous, Extreme) | Ordinal | Color/hue of bars |
| City | Categorical/nominal | Faceting into separate panels; panel labels |
| PM2.5 concentration scale reference | Quantitative | Legend scale and y-axis annotations/gridlines |

- Title indicates the subject is **daily average air pollution around the world**
- The legend explicitly links color to **PM2.5 concentration** and **E.P.A. Air Quality Index** categories.

Faceted vertical bar chart (small-multiple time-series bar charts), with one panel per city.

- **No stacking** visible

| Air quality level / EPA AQI category (Good, Unhealthy, Hazardous, Extreme) | Ordinal | Color/hue of bars |
| City | Categorical/nominal | Faceting into separate panels; panel labels |
| PM2.5 concentration scale reference | Quantitative | Legend scale and y-axis annotations/gridlines |

image_description:
## 1) Chart type
Faceted vertical bar chart (small-multiple time-series bar charts), with one panel per city.

## 2) Layout techniques
- **Faceting / small multiples** by **city**
- **Unequal panel sizes**: some cities (notably New Delhi) are shown in larger panels
- **Color encoding** applied to bars to indicate pollution level / air quality category
- **No stacking** visible

## 3) Data variables

| Data Variable | Type of Variable | Visual Encoding |
|---|---|---|
| Date / day (Nov ’18 to Nov ’19) | Temporal | Position on x-axis within each panel |
| PM2.5 concentration (µg/m³) | Quantitative | Bar height / position on y-axis |
| Air quality level / EPA AQI category (Good, Unhealthy, Hazardous, Extreme) | Ordinal | Color/hue of bars |
| City | Categorical/nominal | Faceting into separate panels; panel labels |
| PM2.5 concentration scale reference | Quantitative | Legend scale and y-axis annotations/gridlines |

Notes visible in the chart:
- Title indicates the subject is **daily average air pollution around the world**
- The legend explicitly links color to **PM2.5 concentration** and **E.P.A. Air Quality Index** categories.

raw_comment: I notice that this is a graph displaying the different air qualities throughout November 2018 to November 2019 in a select few of the major cities around the world. I can see that a few cities like Nairobi and Manhattan are in the healthier side, Los Angeles and Paris are in the unhealthy side while Kampala and Beijing are in very extreme air quality areas. I wonder as to why it is that we see these cities struggling with air quality. I can see that Malaysia and Beijing are both in Asia so it makes me wonder if the density of a region has any influence to its air quality, given that Asia is an extremely dense continent. I also wonder as to why is it that Manhattan is fairly well with air quality while Los Angeles is struggling -- why is it that the coasts vary from air pollution? The impact that this has on my community is not a great deal, but it is definitely a good idea to keep an eye on  air quality as a healthy life style. Given that Manhattan and Boston are relatively close areas, I can assume that the air quality is similar and more on the healthy side. Whenever I check the weather for Boston I always see the air quality index towards the green side, which is always a good sign. Potential catchy headline: "What is Air Quality Like in Major World Cities?"

## 1) Chart type
Faceted vertical bar chart (small-multiple time-series bar charts), with one panel per city.

## 2) Layout techniques
- **Faceting / small multiples** by **city**
- **Unequal panel sizes**: some cities (notably New Delhi) are shown in larger panels
- **Color encoding** applied to bars to indicate pollution level / air quality category
- **No stacking** visible

## 3) Data variables

| Data Variable | Type of Variable | Visual Encoding |
|---|---|---|
| Date / day (Nov ’18 to Nov ’19) | Temporal | Position on x-axis within each panel |
| PM2.5 concentration (µg/m³) | Quantitative | Bar height / position on y-axis |
| Air quality level / EPA AQI category (Good, Unhealthy, Hazardous, Extreme) | Ordinal | Color/hue of bars |
| City | Categorical/nominal | Faceting into separate panels; panel labels |
| PM2.5 concentration scale reference | Quantitative | Legend scale and y-axis annotations/gridlines |

- Title indicates the subject is **daily average air pollution around the world**
- The legend explicitly links color to **PM2.5 concentration** and **E.P.A. Air Quality Index** categories.

## 1) Chart type
Faceted vertical bar chart (small-multiple time-series bar charts), with one panel per city.

## 2) Layout techniques
- **Faceting / small multiples** by **city**

- **Color encoding** applied to bars to indicate pollution level / air quality category
- **No stacking** visible

## 3) Data variables

| Data Variable | Type of Variable | Visual Encoding |
|---|---|---|
| Date / day (Nov ’18 to Nov ’19) | Temporal | Position on x-axis within each panel |
| PM2.5 concentration (µg/m³) | Quantitative | Bar height / position on y-axis |
| Air quality level / EPA AQI category (Good, Unhealthy, Hazardous, Extreme) | Ordinal | Color/hue of bars |
| City | Categorical/nominal | Faceting into separate panels; panel labels |
| PM2.5 concentration scale reference | Quantitative | Legend scale and y-axis annotations/gridlines |

Notes visible in the chart:
- Title indicates the subject is **daily average air pollution around the world**
- The legend explicitly links color to **PM2.5 concentration** and **E.P.A. Air Quality Index** categories.

image_description:
## 1) Chart type
Faceted vertical bar chart (small-multiple time-series bar charts), with one panel per city.

## 2) Layout techniques
- **Faceting / small multiples** by **city**
- **Unequal panel sizes**: some cities (notably New Delhi) are shown in larger panels
- **Color encoding** applied to bars to indicate pollution level / air quality category
- **No stacking** visible

## 3) Data variables

| Data Variable | Type of Variable | Visual Encoding |
|---|---|---|
| Date / day (Nov ’18 to Nov ’19) | Temporal | Position on x-axis within each panel |
| PM2.5 concentration (µg/m³) | Quantitative | Bar height / position on y-axis |
| Air quality level / EPA AQI category (Good, Unhealthy, Hazardous, Extreme) | Ordinal | Color/hue of bars |
| City | Categorical/nominal | Faceting into separate panels; panel labels |
| PM2.5 concentration scale reference | Quantitative | Legend scale and y-axis annotations/gridlines |

Notes visible in the chart:
- Title indicates the subject is **daily average air pollution around the world**
- The legend explicitly links color to **PM2.5 concentration** and **E.P.A. Air Quality Index** categories.

## 1) Chart type
Faceted vertical bar chart (small-multiple time-series bar charts), with one panel per city.

## 2) Layout techniques
- **Faceting / small multiples** by **city**
- **Unequal panel sizes**: some cities (notably New Delhi) are shown in larger panels
- **Color encoding** applied to bars to indicate pollution level / air quality category
- **No stacking** visible

## 3) Data variables

| Data Variable | Type of Variable | Visual Encoding |
|---|---|---|
| Date / day (Nov ’18 to Nov ’19) | Temporal | Position on x-axis within each panel |
| PM2.5 concentration (µg/m³) | Quantitative | Bar height / position on y-axis |
| Air quality level / EPA AQI category (Good, Unhealthy, Hazardous, Extreme) | Ordinal | Color/hue of bars |
| City | Categorical/nominal | Faceting into separate panels; panel labels |
| PM2.5 concentration scale reference | Quantitative | Legend scale and y-axis annotations/gridlines |

Notes visible in the chart:
- Title indicates the subject is **daily average air pollution around the world**
- The legend explicitly links color to **PM2.5 concentration** and **E.P.A. Air Quality Index** categories.

image_description:
## 1) Chart type
Faceted vertical bar chart (small-multiple time-series bar charts), with one panel per city.

## 2) Layout techniques
- **Faceting / small multiples** by **city**
- **Unequal panel sizes**: some cities (notably New Delhi) are shown in larger panels
- **Color encoding** applied to bars to indicate pollution level / air quality category
- **No stacking** visible

## 3) Data variables

| Data Variable | Type of Variable | Visual Encoding |
|---|---|---|
| Date / day (Nov ’18 to Nov ’19) | Temporal | Position on x-axis within each panel |
| PM2.5 concentration (µg/m³) | Quantitative | Bar height / position on y-axis |
| Air quality level / EPA AQI category (Good, Unhealthy, Hazardous, Extreme) | Ordinal | Color/hue of bars |
| City | Categorical/nominal | Faceting into separate panels; panel labels |
| PM2.5 concentration scale reference | Quantitative | Legend scale and y-axis annotations/gridlines |

Notes visible in the chart:
- Title indicates the subject is **daily average air pollution around the world**
- The legend explicitly links color to **PM2.5 concentration** and **E.P.A. Air Quality Index** categories.
